OBJECTIVE
Motivated Computer Science graduate seeking an entry-level Software Engineer position. Possesses strong foundation in Java, Python, JavaScript, React, SQL, Git, and Docker through software engineering internships, academic projects, and hands-on application development.

EDUCATION
Bachelor of Science in Computer Science | University of Washington | 2020 - 2024
- GPA: 3.8/4.0 | Dean's List (All Semesters)
- Relevant Coursework: Data Structures & Algorithms, Web Development, Database Systems, Software Engineering, Operating Systems

WORK EXPERIENCE

- Developed frontend components using React, JavaScript, and CSS3, enhancing user interface responsiveness by 25%.
- Built RESTful API endpoints in Python with FastAPI and SQL PostgreSQL database queries to handle user profile management.
- Containerized microservice applications using Docker and Git for version control in an Agile development environment.
- Fixed 15+ high-priority bug tickets reported during beta testing.

KEY PROJECTS
E-Commerce Microservice App | GitHub: github.com/jordantaylor-dev/shop-app | 2023
- Built full-stack e-commerce application using React, Node.js, Express, PostgreSQL, and Docker.
- Integrated Stripe API for payment processing and JWT for user authentication, serving 500+ test transactions.

Smart Task Manager | GitHub: github.com/jordantaylor-dev/task-master | 2023
- Created task tracking web application with Java, Spring Boot, and SQL, implementing real-time notifications.

TECHNICAL SKILLS
- Languages: Java, Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, SQL, HTML, CSS
- Frameworks & Libraries: React, Node.js, Express, Spring Boot, FastAPI
- Tools & Databases: Git, GitHub, Docker, PostgreSQL, MySQL, Postman, Linux

CERTIFICATIONS
- Meta Front-End Developer Professional Certificate (2023)
- AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner (2024)
jobDescriptionText: Seeking an Entry-Level or Graduate Software Engineer with a BS in Computer Science. Requirements: proficiency in Java, Python, JavaScript, React, SQL, Git, and Docker. Experience with internship or hands-on web development projects preferred.
